visual_elements.description: Neural network diagram: Left side shows input dots feeding into three input nodes (circles with Σ). Middle hidden layer has green nodes (circles with Σ) labeled O_j. Right output layer has orange nodes (circles with Σ) labeled O_k feeding into boxes labeled Output 1, Output 2, Output m. Arrows show weights w_ji between input and hidden, w_kj between hidden and output. Activation function boxes labeled 'f' appear after summation nodes. Bias nodes shown as purple circles with '1'. Curved dashed arrows show error backpropagation paths from outputs. Far right vertical red bar labeled 'Error Error' points to Class 1, Class 2, Class m boxes.
Purple rounded rectangle labeled 'Input Sample' with left-pointing arrow into network
Purple rounded rectangle labeled 'Target Label' with right-pointing arrow from network
Vertical red rectangle with white vertical text 'Error Error'
Blue box labeled 'Previous Layer (l)' with upward arrow labeled 'i'
Green box labeled 'Current Layer (You are here)' with upward arrow labeled 'j'
Orange box labeled 'Next Layer (K)' with upward arrow labeled 'k'
White box with red border labeled 'Note: Layer "j" is NOT Output Layer'
Equation box bottom-left: header 'For Layer "j"', then two equations: Net_j = Σ (w_ji * O_i) and O_j = f(Net_j) = 1 / (1 + e^-Net_j)
Equation bottom-right: E = 1/2 Σ_j (t_j - O_j)^2 followed by three red X marks

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is bold, large, dark red. Subtitle is bold, blue. Body labels are black, regular weight. Equation text is black, smaller. Some text is all-caps or mixed case as shown.
